results.name: VictimSupportNI
results.text:
Join our team!

We are currently hiring for an Administration and Support Officer in our Foyle Hub.

The main purpose of the role involves providing initial support to victims and witnesses of crime, along with maintaining effective administrative systems that support this engagement process.

If you are organised, empathetic, and committed to helping others, we would like to hear from you.

To apply, visit: https://t.co/4eoNVmyvgl or head to our website to find out more.
